description: Gravatar on registration: the registration request now makes an outbound HTTP call with no timeout, so a slow or unreachable Gravatar hangs registration workers indefinitely.
notes: FM-06 (time and resource budgets). gravatar_for() runs in the post_save signal, inside the registration request, and calls urlopen() with no timeout. Python's default socket timeout is None, so when Gravatar is slow or the network blackholes the connection, each registration blocks its sync worker indefinitely, and a handful of them exhausts the worker pool. Severity important: FM-06 grades important. Fix: pass a short timeout (for example urlopen(..., timeout=2)), or move the lookup out of the request path. Scored range: the whole gravatar_for function (signals.py:18-28), because the natural Where line is the function as well as the urlopen call (23). Catching OSError, which keeps the default image on a 404 or URLError, is legitimate.
